description: Use this when the user asks for a league-wide list: standings, NBA Keel Impact player ratings, NFL EPA per play for offenses and defenses, or weekly power rankings ('top 10 NFL defenses by EPA'). Returns the ranked list with the url of its table (Pro adds the ratings' offense/defense, box prior, RAPM and on/off parts). Not for one team or player: use their profile.

kind.description: What leaderboard to fetch: "ratings" (NBA Keel Impact), "efficiency" (NFL EPA/play), "standings", or "power_rankings".

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

name: rankings_and_ratings
title: Rankings, Standings & Player Ratings
